 - If all params are resolved but the render still hits uncached data or runtime APIs (`cookies`, `headers`) wrapped in `<Suspense>` boundaries, the upgrade produces a **cached page with those fallbacks**. The uncached or runtime parts stream in at request time.
 - Params are resolved in route order. A param value not returned by `generateStaticParams` stays unresolved and prevents any deeper params from upgrading.
 
+### Deferring expensive content
+
+Because links to these pages use `prefetch={true}`, each prefetch also prepares content that depends on `cookies` or `headers`. Consider showing each price in the visitor's currency. The currency comes from a cookie, and converting the price calls an exchange-rate service, so every prefetch of a product link would run that conversion. Use [`await navigation()`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/navigation) before it. The prefetch leaves the converted price out, and it renders when the user navigates.
